description: DRAFT (feature 003, R12). Owned by cpp-context-hearing-nows (hearingnows-event-processor/src/yaml/json/schema/). accountingDivisionCode.description: CIMD-4640: accountDivisionCode of the defendant's enforcement area, resolved by the enforcement workflow from reference data (referencedata.query.enforcement-area) by the defendant's postcode, else by the hearing court's LJA, as the NOWS functions do for financialOrderDetails. Absent when reference data has no enforcement area for either. hearing-nows renders it as nowContent.enforcementFinancialOrderDetails.accountingDivisionCode
